race.title: 'Play Coral Racing-Super-Series For Free' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: BOSTON JURY looks as if he has revived for his new yard so he could be the answer with the return to this longer trip sure to suit. This does look competitive, though, with handicap debutant Allfor and course specialist The Jeweller's Pet completing the shortlist. BOSTON JURY (IRE) ALLFOR (IRE) THE JEWELLER'S PET (IRE)
